evals.name: spec-verification-delegates-explorer-not-main-direct-read
evals.prompt: 이 spec이 실제로 구현됐는지 확인해줘. auth 모듈이랑 session 관련 파일 여러 개 봐야할 것 같아.
evals.expected_output: 메인이 직접 파일을 read 하지 않고 oh-my-claudecode:explore (sonnet) subagent 를 dispatch 해서 Step 0.5~8 전체를 실행. 5+ 파일 read 는 메인 직접 금지 규칙 적용.

assertions.text: Response dispatches oh-my-claudecode:explore with model=sonnet for the survey, not reading files directly in main context
Response cites or applies the rule that 5+ file reads are forbidden in main context per §Preparation phase delegation
Response specifies running all steps Step 0.5 (CRG index verify) through Step 8 (report save) in order
Response specifies saving the survey report to docs/harness/surveys/YYYY-MM-DD-<topic>-survey.md
Response references code-review-graph (CRG) for scope expansion in Step 1, with grep as fallback if CRG unavailable
